name: tickets
description: KIA Tigers Seoul-away ticket-sale helper (GitHub Pages) plus optional local notes API.

scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w client && node scripts/sms-reminder.mjs --self-test && node scripts/sms-reminder.test.mjs && node scripts/sms-scheduler-toggle.mjs --self-test && node scripts/sync-games.test.mjs
scripts.pages:sync: BASE_PATH=/tickets/ npm run build -w client && node scripts/sync-pages-fallback.mjs
